audit.whatIsWrong: A mechanical impossibility repeated twice: wants.you[1] says "Hold Null Sphere's shield to absorb the CH-2 grenade stun" and early says "Hold the Null Sphere shield to eat the CH-2 grenade stun rather than burning it on poke". A shield absorbs damage; it has no effect on crowd control. The reader is being told to hold a button that will not stop the thing they are afraid of. Separately, breakdown.late says to 'Q-silence the counterplay' - Null Sphere has no silence. And UPGRADE!!!, his ultimate, is not named anywhere in either layer.
audit.why: Riot's Null Sphere text is damage, channel interrupt, and a shield that absorbs magic damage - nothing about CC. The correction matters because it changes the action: the grenade stuns only enemies DIRECTLY hit and merely slows everything around the impact, so the answer is to sidestep the centre, not to hold a shield. Two other interactions the page needed: Hextech Affinity gives him Move Speed near his own deployed turrets, which is why he kites so well inside the nest and why chasing him through it fails. And UPGRADE!!! at 100/85/70s banks one empowered spell - an upgraded grenade is the version that actually kills you, so the ultimate icon is the real green/red light, not the grenade itself.
audit.corrected: The shield-stops-the-stun claim replaced with the grenade's direct-hit-only stun and a sidestep instruction; the silence removed; Hextech Affinity's turret Move Speed and UPGRADE!!!'s 100s bank added.
sources: champ-data/_kits/heimerdinger.json (P Hextech Affinity: 'Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger'; E: 'stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units', cooldown 11; R UPGRADE!!! 100/85/70)

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Heimerdinger six of seven stages and Skill the seventh, so no stage reads Kassadin - while spikes[3] says 2+ items is 'the only window the lane is yours', whys[6] says you 'one-combo an immobile Heimer', and late calls it 'the window you suffered for'.
audit.why: Kassadin loses this 45.45% over 11 games, so a Heimerdinger-heavy chart is the right overall shape. But the 2+ items stage is the single place all three prose sources agree the lane has changed hands, and the chart contradicts every one of them.
audit.corrected: 2+ items flipped to Kassadin in both layers. Every earlier stage left with Heimerdinger - the range gap (1325 rockets and a 970 grenade against a 650 Q and a 500 blink) makes that read correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: CH-2 is named the matchup-defining cooldown in six places with no duration attached, and the ultimate spike is missing altogether because UPGRADE!!! is never mentioned.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank - short enough that waiting it out is not a plan, which is exactly why the direct-hit-only stun matters more than the timer. Hextech Micro-Rockets are 11/10/9/8/7s at 1325 range. UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70s. Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s over a 500-unit hop, so at rank 1 one blink does not clear a 1325-range rocket line - the 2s rank 3 blink is what actually crosses the turret nest, and that is the mechanism behind the 2+ items flip.
audit.corrected: CH-2's flat 11s, the rockets' 1325 range, UPGRADE!!!'s 100s and Riftwalk's 5-to-2s spread written into the spikes, mid and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names CH-2 as matchup-defining and then says only 'dodge it before diving' and 'check it before every step-up' - no number, and no mention of the ultimate.
audit.why: An 11-second flat cooldown is not something you wait out between last-hits. Reframing the block around UPGRADE!!!'s 100s and the grenade's direct-hit requirement gives the reader something they can actually act on.
audit.corrected: Numbers added and the block re-pointed at the ultimate as the real gate.

audit.whatIsWrong: full.tldr is generic boilerplate - 'If his damage is magic, your Q eats it - if it's physical, this is a real lane' - shared verbatim with other Kassadin matchups.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's entire kit is magic damage, so the conditional resolves to one branch and the page could simply say so. Void Stone reduces incoming magic and Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic, which makes Kassadin unusually well-armoured against this specific opponent - a genuine and unstated advantage that a hedged tldr throws away.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to state the resolved case: his damage is all magic, both your defensive tools bite, and the problem is range rather than damage.

edits.before: Heimer's turrets are the whole problem — the H-28G nest zones the wave so hard that your single Null Sphere can't reach a last-hit without standing in turret beams plus a Micro-Rocket. Don't try to trade: you have no Nether Blade mana back yet and your Q is mana-hungry and short-ranged. Hold the Null Sphere shield to eat the CH-2 grenade stun rather than burning it on poke, because if his E lands you take a full rocket-plus-turret-crossfire combo with no blink to escape until 6. Concede the wave, last-hit what you safely can under tower, and accept you're losing this stage.
edits.after: Heimer's turrets are the whole problem - the H-28 G nest zones the wave so hard that your single Null Sphere can't reach a last-hit without standing in turret beams plus a Micro-Rocket volley from 1325 range. Don't try to trade: you have no Nether Blade mana back yet and your Q is mana-hungry and short-ranged. His CH-2 grenade is an 11-second cooldown that stuns only what it hits dead-centre and slows everything around the rim, so sidestep the middle rather than saving a shield for it - the shield eats damage and the stun lands regardless. Concede the wave, last-hit what you can under tower, and accept this stage is lost.

edits.before: This stays rough. Nether Blade keeps your mana afloat off auto-attacks and a maxed Null Sphere helps you survive, but you still can't walk into a triple-turret nest to fight a ranged AP who out-ranges every tool you have. At 6, Riftwalk is a survival button — blink to dodge the CH-2 grenade or a gank, not to all-in, because the turrets will shred you before you kill him. Farm under tower, dodge the grenade, and roam with your blink: Heimer is immobile and stuck shoving turrets, so he can't follow or punish you leaving the lane.
edits.after: This stays rough. Nether Blade keeps your mana afloat off auto-attacks and a maxed Null Sphere helps you survive, but a 5s Riftwalk covering 500 units does not walk you into a triple-turret nest against 1325-range rockets. Hextech Affinity speeds him up near his own turrets, so chasing him through the nest is how you die. At 6, blink to dodge the grenade or a gank, not to all-in. Farm under tower and roam with your blink: Heimer is immobile and stuck shoving turrets, so he can't follow or punish you leaving.

edits.before: This is the window you suffered for. Once Riftwalk is stacking and you've got Nashor's or Lich Bane plus Rabadon's, you blink straight through his turret line — Void Stone's 15% magic reduction and your Q shield blank his rocket poke, and a single re-stacked Riftwalk combo deletes him before he can land the CH-2 stun. He's a turret-bound immobile mage with no answer to a blink-spam assassin in his face the moment you're off his turrets. Force every fight where you can reach him directly and never let him plant a fresh nest with you on top of him.
edits.after: This is the window you suffered for. Watch UPGRADE!!! instead: at 100 seconds it banks one empowered spell, and the upgraded grenade is the version that kills you. Force every fight where you can reach him directly, and never let him plant a fresh nest on top of you.

notes: MECHANICAL IMPOSSIBILITY, twice: wants.you[1] and early both told the reader to hold Null Sphere's shield to absorb the CH-2 grenade STUN. A shield absorbs damage and does nothing to crowd control - Riot's Null Sphere text is damage, channel interrupt, and a magic-absorbing shield. The real counterplay is in the grenade's own text: it stuns only enemies hit DEAD-CENTRE and merely slows those around the impact, so you sidestep it. Also fixed: breakdown.late called Null Sphere a silence. Two interactions were absent from both layers and are now in - Hextech Affinity grants Move Speed near his own deployed turrets (which is why chasing him through the nest fails), and UPGRADE!!!, his ultimate, was never named anywhere despite being the 100/85/70s bank that makes one grenade lethal. Numbers added throughout: grenade flat 11s, rockets 11/10/9/8/7s at 1325 range against your 650 Q and 500 blink. full.tldr was generic boilerplate offering an if-magic/if-physical conditional; against Heimerdinger the answer is always magic, and that makes Void Stone plus the Q shield an unstated structural advantage, so I resolved the conditional. LEVEL CHART: no stage read Kassadin, while spikes[3], whys[6] and late all call 2+ items his window - flipped that one stage in both layers.
